name: taskflow
description: TaskFlow - aplicación de tareas con tablero Kanban y dashboard

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @taskflow/api" "npm run dev -w @taskflow/web"
scripts.test: npm run test:shared && npm run test:api && npm run test:web
scripts.test:e2e: npm run db:test:prepare -w @taskflow/api && npm run test -w @taskflow/e2e
scripts.test:all: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run test:e2e
scripts.load:up:1: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f loadtest/compose.yml up -d --build --scale api=1 && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f loadtest/compose.yml restart web
scripts.load:up:3: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f loadtest/compose.yml up -d --build --scale api=3 && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f loadtest/compose.yml restart web
scripts.load:run: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f loadtest/compose.yml run --rm k6
